negative tests for changed sources, axes and unsupported PIT fields

qualification_and_domain: These are the existing research loader compatibility requirements, not proof of production source quality. Keep full all_common golden membership, independently audit exact export-to-role alignment, and disclose the distinct ADV top-N role denominator. Retain actual basis and historical qualifications; incompatible sources require a separately reviewed adapter, not false metadata.
